# CG-API-005: Path parameter renamed

A path template variable changed name at the same position.

**Why it matters:** Template names are not sent on the wire.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Operations and paths](./#api) |
| Detects | `path.parameterRenamed` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Path parameter &#123;&#123;from}} was renamed to &#123;&#123;to}}.
>
> The URL on the wire is unchanged; only generated code that exposes the name is affected.
>
> **Fix:** No wire change. Check generated SDKs if names matter.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: {id} → {userId}

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /u/{id}: {get: {parameters: [{name: id, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /u/{userId}: {get: {parameters: [{name: userId, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** Informational, info. Path parameter {id} was renamed to {userId}.

### Does not fire: segment moved to another position

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
-   /a/{id}/b: {get: {parameters: [{name: id, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
+   /a/b/{id}: {get: {parameters: [{name: id, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- SDK generators may expose the name.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-API-005
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
```
